class.name: z1_ros2_control/Z1System
class.description:
Real Unitree Z1 arm behind the official z1_controller.
Declares a joint position command interface (joint1..joint6, plus jointGripper when the URDF has it) and position/velocity/effort state interfaces, all from a single 208-byte RecvState datagram per cycle.
The official z1_ctrl process must be running on the same machine: it owns the 250 Hz loop to the arm, the finite state machine, the inverse kinematics and the collision detection, and this component only exchanges SendCmd/RecvState datagrams with it on 127.0.0.1.
Must be declared is_async="true" rw_rate="500" - see the package README.
